speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a chronic wound on your right lower leg; to help me understand the cause, can you tell me how long this wound has been present and whether you have a history of diabetes or vascular disease?

speaker: Patient
text: 57-year-old male. The patient reports a large wound on his right lower leg that has been present for 6 months. He mentions that his legs have been chronically swollen for over 10 years and that his mother and brother had similar leg problems. He had a documented deep vein thrombosis (DVT) in the affected leg 5 years ago but has no other significant past medical history.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you. Given the history of DVT and chronic swelling, I suspect venous insufficiency. Can you describe the appearance of the wound, specifically if the edges are irregular and the surrounding skin is discolored or hardened?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Large wound on the right lower leg. I also have Chronic leg swelling, Family history of similar leg problems.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the wound drain any fluid, and do you experience pain or itching in the surrounding skin? Additionally, does elevating your leg provide any relief from the swelling?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Deep vein thrombosis in the right leg 5 years prior. No other significant medical history. Social history: Non-smoker, drinks alcohol socially. Works as an accountant.

speaker: Doctor
text: The history of DVT, chronic swelling, and family history strongly points to post-thrombotic syndrome leading to a venous stasis ulcer. I will request a vascular assessment to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Ankle_Branch_Index

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal Ankle-Brachial Index rules out significant arterial disease, which supports my suspicion of a venous etiology. To further confirm venous insufficiency, I need to assess the valve function in your leg veins. REQUEST TEST: Venous_Duplex_Ultrasound

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Evidence of venous reflux and obstruction in superficial and deep venous systems of the right leg

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound confirms venous reflux and obstruction, which, combined with your history of DVT and chronic swelling, confirms post-thrombotic syndrome. DIAGNOSIS READY: Venous Stasis Ulcer
